faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Our return policy allows returns within 30 days of purchase with original receipt.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: You can reset your password by clicking 'Forgot Password' on the login page.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can contact support via email at support@example.com or call 1-800-123-4567.

faqs.question: What are your business hours?
faqs.answer: Our business hours are Monday-Friday 9 AM - 6 PM EST.
